name: SVC_INBOUND_MSG_FILTERS
description: This table contains the details of all the filters which gets applied to any message received on the respective client application

columns.name: FILTER_ID
columns.description: Auto-generated number and primary key for this table.

columns.name: FILTER_TYPE_CD
columns.description: This column contains the lookup code that indicates the filter type. POSSIBLE VALUES : Content, header, metadata, recipient, replyto, sender, subject, custom

columns.name: FIELD_NAME
columns.description:
This column contains the field name on which this filter is to be applied. 
In case of header/metadata : specifies the header name
In case of custom filter : specifies the message part on which filter is to be applied .e.g AttachmentType or AttachmentMime

columns.name: PATTERN
columns.description: This column contains Value of the filter which gets applied to the client application. Specifies the pattern of the filter

columns.name: ACTION_CD
columns.description:
This column contains the lookup code that indicates the action that has to be taken on a filter
Possible Values : ACCEPT, REJECT

columns.name: ORDER_NUMBER
columns.description: This Column contains the order in which this filter has to be applied to the client.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: This column contains a brief description about the filter

columns.name: CUSTOM_FILTER_FLAG
columns.description: This column indicates whether the filter is standard UMS filter or is user defined.

columns.name: DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: This column indicates whether the filter is logically deleted or not

columns.name: CLIENT_APPLICATION_NAME
columns.description: This column contains the Client application name for which this filter gets applied

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
